title: Assessment Metabolic Flexibility in Middle-aged Individuals: The Nutritional Impact of Cheese Consumption
official: Assessment Metabolic Flexibility by Indirect Calorimetry and Circulating Metabolic Parameters in Middle-aged Individuals: The Nutritional Impact of Cheese From Extensive and Intensive Farming.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 45-65 years of age
* BMI \< 27
* waist-to-hip ratio female\<0.85; male \< 0.98

Exclusion Criteria:

* metabolic diseases
* Physical activity of competitive nature
* Vegans and vegetarians
* Intolerances and allergies to the foods under study
